tools.name: prepare_publish
tools.zodSchema: z.object({ databaseId: z.string().min(1).max(128), properties: z.record(z.any()), content: z.array(z.record(z.any())).max(50).optional(), approvalToken: z.string().min(8).max(256) }).strict()

tools.name: reconcile_publish
tools.zodSchema: z.object({ sequence: z.number().int().min(1), approvalToken: z.string().min(8).max(256), action: z.enum(["confirm_committed", "confirm_not_committed", "abandon"]), externalId: z.string().min(1).max(256).optional() }).strict()
